svg.title: One discrete PID update after another
svg.desc: After the 1.5 radian step the request of 24.9 newton-metres is clipped to 20 for six updates while tracking pulls the kept integral below the trial integral; inside the limits the two are equal, and the integral peaks at 2.92 newton-metres before falling towards the 1.962 the load needs.
svg.text: One discrete PID update after another
Control Studio recording of this project · 0.02 s updates · 1.5 rad step at 1.00 s with a 1.962 N·m load · numbers answer the predictions
1.84 s, inside the limits: I = I* = 2.768 N·m
Peak 2.92 N·m at 2.42 s; 2.25 N·m at 7 s, still falling
